cases.explain: The nominative case is used for the subject in apposition.

cases.sentence: У Мишелемии были сыновья. Первый сын был Захария, второй ___ был Иедеаил.
cases.translation: Meshelemiah had sons. The first was Zechariah, the second son was Jediael.
cases.explain: Predicate nominative after 'был' (was) requires nominative case.

cases.translation: In the treasury the treasures of God's house were kept.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Вождем хевронитов был Иерия, могучий ___ из Израиля.
cases.translation: The chief of the Hebronites was Jerijah, a mighty man from Israel.
cases.explain: Nominative case for predicate nominative after 'был' (was).

cases.sentence: Из хевронитов Хашавия и его родственники, 1700 способных людей, отвечали в ___ за все дела Господа.
cases.translation: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his relatives, 1700 capable men, had charge in Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) with location uses prepositional case.

cases.translation: The eastward gates fell by lot to Shelemiah.

cases.sentence: У Мишелемии было 18 сыновей и родственников, которые были способными людьми, служившими в ___ Господа.
cases.translation: Meshelemiah had eighteen sons and brothers, able men who served in the house of the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governing location takes prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Все они были потомками Авита ___ и были очень способными людьми.
cases.translation: They were all descendants of Obed-Edom's family and were very able men.
cases.explain: Genitive case shows possession: 'descendants of Obed-Edom's house'.

reading.question: Who did God bless according to this verse?
reading.explain: The text states Бог благословил Авито дома — God blessed Obed-Edom.

reading.ru: Шелемиту и его родственникам были вверены все сокровищницы для вещей, посвященных царем Давидом.
reading.question: What were Shelomoth and his brothers given charge of?
reading.explain: Shelomoth and his brothers were entrusted with all treasuries of dedicated things.

reading.ru: Из Ицгаритов Хинани и его сыновьям были определены обязанности за пределами дома.
reading.question: What were Chenaniah and his sons assigned to do?
reading.explain: The text says Chenaniah and his sons had duties за пределами дома — outside the house.

reading.ru: В сороковой год правления Давида родословные записи хевронитян были исследованы.
reading.question: When were genealogical records of the Hebronites examined?
options: In the fortieth year of David's reign
reading.correct: In the fortieth year of David's reign
reading.explain: The text states в сороковой год правления Давида — in the fortieth year of David's reign.

reading.ru: Восточные ворота выпали по жребию Шелемии, затем был брошен жребий для его сына Захарии.
reading.question: Which gates fell by lot to Shelemiah, and to whom did the next lot go?
options: Eastward gates to Shelemiah; then northward to his son Zechariah
Western gates to Shelemiah; then southern to Zechariah
Northern gates to Shelemiah; eastern to Zechariah
Southern gates to Shelemiah; westward to Zechariah
reading.correct: Eastward gates to Shelemiah; then northward to his son Zechariah
reading.explain: The eastward gates fell to Shelemiah, then the north gates to his son Zechariah.

reading.ru: Шестеро левитов каждый день стояли на восточной стороне, четверо на северной, четверо на южной и подвое у кладовых.
reading.question: How were the Levites distributed at the different gate positions?
options: 6 at the east, 4 at north, 4 at south, 2 at storage
4 at each gate plus 4 at storage
reading.correct: 6 at the east, 4 at north, 4 at south, 2 at storage
reading.explain: The text lists: Шестеро на восточной, четверо на северной, четверо на южной и подвое у кладовых.
